scripts.build: tsc -p packages/logo/tsconfig.build.json && bun run build:ui && tsc -p packages/shell/tsconfig.build.json
scripts.size: bun build scripts/size-log-only.ts --minify --target=browser | gzip -c | wc -c && bun build packages/shell/src/index.ts --minify --target=browser | gzip -c | wc -c
scripts.link:local: bun install && (cd packages/logo && bun link) && (cd packages/shell && bun link)
